remarks: Enter through a graceful white arbor and gate, where winding brick pathways meander through a romantic garden sanctuary filled with lush landscaping, timeless coastal charm, and nostalgia for days gone by. Beneath a magnificent shade tree, dappled sunlight falls across a charming garden swing. Elegant brickwork, curated greenery, and intimate seating invite you to linger beside a striking brick fireplace, perfect for quiet mornings, sunset gatherings, and evenings beneath the stars. A built-in barbecue completes the setting for summer dinners and outdoor entertaining, all on one of Balboa Island’s most desirable streets.
